Commentary.Commentary: Now we believe Malaysia Women have been batted out of the game. Like we saw in the first innings though, they will probably come out and enjoy their batting too. India on the other hand will want to take quick wickets and will be aiming for a big win here. Join us for the chase in a bit.

Malaysia Women really enjoyed themselves. Their bowlers were taken to the cleaners but they really enjoed themselves. They gave it their all, there were a few dropped chances but a few good catches too. Nur Dania Syuhada will never forget this day as she got two in one over. Winifred Duraisingam will also be pleased to get a couple of wickets.

India have managed to post the highest total of the tournament so far! This is just what their skipper would have wanted when she elected to bat. The openers set the tone with a 100-plus stand. Sabbhineni Meghana was the star with a blazing knock. She fell but Richa Ghosh and Shafali Verma continued the good work as they put on yet another quick fire stand. Verma fell 4 short of a half ton and then there was a small procession. However, Dayalan Hemalatha ensured her side got over the 180-run mark with a few meaty blows.
SIX! Yes, Dayalan Hemalatha can! INDIA END WITH 181! On middle, this is lofted over the long on fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Dayalan Hemalatha steps out, she gets to the pitch of the ball and smacks it through covers. A biggie to cross 180, can they do it?
A yorker outside off, Dayalan Hemalatha fails to jam it out.
Two more! On middle, Dayalan Hemalatha swings, it goes off the top edge towards third man for two.
OUT! TAKEN ON THE SECOND ATTEMPT! Another one bites the dust! Malaysia Women finishing strongly. On middle, this is lofted down to the long on fielder. She takes it on the second attempt.
Commentary.Howout: c Sasha Azmi b Winifred Duraisingam

Commentary.Commentary: On off, this is hit towards mid off for one.
FOUR! On middle, this is hit wide of deep square leg for another boundary. Two in a row to end an action-packed over.
FOUR! Just wide! Radha steps out and hits it wide of the fielder at long on. She runs there and dives but can't get to it. A boundary.
DROPPED! That could have been three in the over! On middle, Richa Ghosh heaves it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs in but spills it. A single taken.
A loud appeal but turned down! On the pads, Radha Yadav looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and goes behind for one. Leg bye.

OUT! TAKEN! Two in two for Nur Dania Syuhada! She is over the moon! On middle, Kiran Navgire plays the slog sweep but it goes off the toe-end. The fielder at deep square leg takes it. Nur Dania Syuhada is on a hat-trick.
Commentary.Howout: c Nur Arianna Natsya b Nur Dania Syuhada

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! TIMBER! Nur Dania Syuhada strikes on her very first ball! Where has she been all this while? Gets the well-set Shafali Verma who walks back 4 short of a half ton! This is shorter and outside off, comes slow off the surface. Verma looks to punch it but it goes off the inside edge and onto the stumps.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for another single.
On middle, Richa Ghosh hits it to long on for one.
Shorter and outside off, Ghosh looks to cut, it goes off the underedge and hits the keeper low on her pads.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Richa Ghosh looks to flick but misses.
FOUR! Cut away! Shorter and outside off, this is flayed through point for a boundary.
Another one on off, Verma strokes it through covers for one.
On off, this is hit to cover.
FOUR MORE! On off, this is slammed down to the long off fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Misfield and it races away! Innocation from Richa Ghosh. She plays the reverse sweep. The fielder at backward point is done in by the spin on the ball. Boundary.
WIDE! Another one well wide outside off. Not played at.
On off, this is hit down to long off for one.
This is even wider outside off, the keeper fails to take it and a run is taken.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut but to point.
FOUR! Another boundary for Richa Ghosh who has got a move on! Another sweep and this is nailed through square leg for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is hit to cover.
SIX! All the way! Tossed up on middle, Richa Ghosh once again plays the slog sweep, this time times it brilliantly and all the way over the square leg fence.
FOUR! Gets it over this time! On middle, Richa Ghosh plays the sweep and hits it over square leg. Boundary.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
Another sweep, this time past square leg and towards the fielder in the deep. One taken.
Another dot! On middle, this is swept but to square leg.
End of a really good over by Mahirah Izzati Ismail! A single to end, on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Was that a chance? Yes! Richa Ghosh steps out and this is bowled outside off. She yorks herself and fails to jam it out. The keeper does not collect it. Not an easy take for the keeper though.
Another dot! On off, this is pushed to cover.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On off, Verma finds the fielder at cover.
Another single as this is hit through covers.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Stop the press, Malaysia Women have managed to get a wicket and they are elated. Despite being so behind in the game. they have really enjoyed this wicket. Excellent scenes. Sabbhineni Meghana will be gutted, there was a ton on offer but she falls. A full ball on off, a little too full. Sabbhineni Meghana fails to get under it. She hits it straight to the fielder at cover.
Commentary.Howout: c Mahirah Izzati Ismail b Winifred Duraisingam

Commentary.Commentary: A single as this is pushed towards cover.
WIDE! Another one well outside off, not played at.
SIX! Colossal! That is some hit! This is fuller and on middle, right in the slot for Verma. She lofts it well over the long on fence for a big one.
Fuller and outside off, Verma strokes it to cover.
A low full toss, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap! A full toss, this is hit between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
This turns back in and also stays low. Outside off, this does not bounce a lot. Sabbhineni Meghana pushes it to covers.
Another extra as this is bowled well outside off.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
Two dots in a row. Quite a rarity. A low full toss, this is hit hard but back to the bowler.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone. 100 up for India.
Now she keeps strike as she strokes it down to long off.
SIX! Over the fence! Shafali Verma steps out, gets to the pitch of it and hits it well over the long on fielder. That is a massive hit.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Finds the fence! On middle, this is whipped wide of the fielder at long on. The fielder runs to her right but fails to stop it.
On middle, fuller, this is whipped wide of long on. The fielder dives and keeps it down to one.
On off, fuller, this is lofted down to long off. It goes on the bounce to the fielder. Only one.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through cover for one more.
FOUR! This is tossed up on off, Sabbhineni Meghana makes room and lifts it over cover for another boundary.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, this is lofted towards long on. It lands short. Just the one.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
On middle, this is hit back to the bowler.

DRINKS! India are off to a brilliant start! Both the openers came out all guns blazing, Sabbhineni Meghana has been the one going after the bowlers and Shafali Verma is playing second fiddle. More of the same is what India want. Malaysia Women need wickets or they'll be batted out of the game here.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through cover for one.
On middle, defended.

FOUR! Poweful stroke and that is fifty for Sabbhineni Meghana! She did get a life earlier on but this is a superb knock! She steps out, gets to the pitch of it and heaves it to the right of the long off fielder. Boundary.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Shorter in length, Sabbhineni Meghana pulls but to mid-wicket. A slight fumble sees the batters take one.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Tossed up well outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana lifts it over cover and this races away to the fence.
Another one as Sabbhineni Meghana lifts it towards mid on.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Fuller and outside off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is chopped to cover.
A low full toss on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
A low full toss on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Fires this outside off, Shafali Verma looks to sweep but misses.
Outside off, this is cut through point for one.
THREE WIDES! Well outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana misses the cut. The keeper fails to collect it. Three taken as it goes to third man.
Another run as this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shortish again and this is punched down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled down to long on for one more.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
BEATEN! Shorter and outside off, stays low again. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to cut but misses.
Verma steps out, she gets to the pitch of it and hits it towards long off for one.
Sabbhineni Meghana now takes one as she milks it to long on.
Follows the boundary with a single as this is hit down to long off.
FOUR! Fifty up for India! On middle, this is swept past square leg and it races away to the fence.
A dot to end the Powerplay but a good one for India! On off, this is pushed to cover.
FOUR! Just wide of the fielder and into the fence! Fuller, in the slot, Sabbhineni Meghana lifts it wide of long off. The fielder runs to her left but it is out of reach. Boundary.
Good length and on off, it is pushed to cover.
Another run as this is pushed down to long on.
SIX! Over the fence! Superb stroke again. Shafali Verma now joins the act! Fuller and on middle, Verma lofts it over the long on fence for a big one.
Shortish and outside off, it is played to cover.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
FOUR! Shot! Sabbhineni Meghana is in some form here. That drop catch is proving very costly already. On middle, this is heaved over the long on fielder for a one-bounce boundary.
On off, shortish, this is played to covers.
Shorter and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana guides it to point.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! SHOT! Shorter and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana cuts it through point for another boundary.
A dot to end! On middle, this is clipped to mid-wicket.
A single as this is hit down to long on.
On off, defended.
FOUR! Cut away! Shorter and outside off, this is played through point for another boundary. Sabbhineni Meghana is dealing in boundaries.
Angled into the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
Outside off, Verma slashes but misses.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! This time gets it over. This is a lot closer to the batter, on off, Sabbhineni Meghana manages to get under it, she lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
On middle, this is hit through mid on for one.
On off, this is cut through point for one.

DROPPED! That should have been taken! On off, Sabbhineni Meghana looks to loft it over mid off but it goes more off the toe-end. It goes towards mid off, the fielder dives forward and looks to take it but spills it. A life for Sabbhineni Meghana. Can prove costly as she has begun brilliantly.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
A single to end! A better second over for Malaysia Women!  Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Angled into middle, Sabbhineni Meghana flicks it to mid-wicket.
Nicely timed! Length and on off, this is stroked through covers for one.
Angled into the pads, Sabbhineni Meghana flicks it through square leg and takes one.
Another single as Shafali Verma now eases it down to long on.
A single as this is hit down to long on. Really good start for Sabbhineni Meghana and India.
On middle, this is nudged through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Shorter and outside off, this is pushed, past the diving fielder at cover and into the fence.
SIX! Over the fence! That is a top shot. Lovely way to get off the mark. This is full and outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana lifts it over cover and it sails over the fence.
This is very wide outside off, had Sabbhineni Meghana left it alone, would have been a wide. She chases it and it goes off the inner half to cover.
Low bounce again! Outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana once again strokes it to covers.
Not a lot of bounce to begin with! Outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana pushes it to covers.
Time for the game to begin! The players make their way out to the middle. Shafali Verma and Sabbhineni Meghana are the openers. Sasha Azmi to begin. Here we go...

Harmanpreet Kaur says they wanted to bat as they want to give opportunities to other batters. Mentions they are always happy whenever they get a chance to play. Adds they are not looking at any target and they just want to make most of this opportunity. Informs they have four changes.

Winifred Duraisingam says they wanted to field and that is what they got. Adds it is a special day to play against India, they have a young squad and they are very excited. Informs they have one change.

India Women (PLAYING XI) - Shafali Verma, Sabbhineni Meghana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Dayalan Hemalatha, Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Kiran Navgire, Radha Yadav, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Meghna Singh.

Malaysia Women (PLAYING XI) - Winifred Duraisingam (C), Mas Elysa, Ainna Hashim, Wan Julia (WK), Mahirah Izzati Ismail, Nur Arianna Natsya, Elsa Hunter, Noor Hayati Zakaria, Jamahidaya Intan, Sasha Azmi, Nur Dania Syuhada.
